value.rationale: The unique mod-two middle-homology class of this spherical three-manifold is a natural dual-surface class, so its minimum induced vertex support is a natural combinatorial systolic invariant. The result completely resolves the first support layer and shows that every minimizer simplifies, without losing a support vertex, to the same topological surface N3. This surface-level structure is not encoded by the known homology group or face vector.
